method: Manual native-resolution source inspection with coordinate grids and magnified ambiguous trigger details. trigger marks the clear opening immediately ahead of the trigger face; grip marks palm contact, not an index-finger target. supportSegment identifies the inspected handguard/foregrip contact surface; it may be vertical on a foregrip. Generic receiver, magazine, belt, bipod and exposed barrel pixels are not accepted as handguards. Explicitly documented short housing exceptions have medium confidence. supportSegment and preferredSupport are null if no trustworthy surface is present; needsPoseReview then blocks automatic acceptance. stockExtent is [left, top, right, bottom]. Alpha sampling verifies points touch the intended source surfaces after manual selection, never selects surfaces automatically. Metadata is an inspection aid, not proof of accepted runtime armor fits.
